availability.note: Hyundai AU IONIQ 6 page shows only the IONIQ 6 N; Hyundai's car price calculator data (fetched 2026-11-26, postcode 3000) lists 'IONIQ 6 N' priced and not sold out, as two variants (N, N with sunroof) at the same price, so one row. The legacy 'IONIQ 6' calculator entry has no category or calculator link. CarExpert 2027 model page lists the N as the only 2027 Ioniq 6 (released 4 Oct 2026).

listPrice.note: MY27 N: CarExpert 'prices starting at $114,918 before on-road costs' (drive-away from $122,781 Sydney). Hyundai's own calculator data for the N variant returned mlpFromPIM 114918 (with a separate LCT-exclusive 'mlp' of 109,551 and Vic drive-away 123,511 incl. $1,995 dealer delivery), so the manufacturer figure agrees. Replaces the MY26 launch price of $115,000 (CarExpert review 7 May 2026). App round-trip: drive-away 120,625 (app excludes dealer delivery).

batteryKwh.note: usable 80.0; nominal 84.0 on the same page. Hyundai AU spec sheet prints 'Capacity 84.0 kWh', which is gross: 84,000 Wh / 384 cells = 218.75 Wh per SK On pouch cell.

rangeKm.note: Hyundai AU MY27 spec sheet (dated 23 Oct 2026): 'All Electric Range (WLTP) 487 km'; EV Database WLTP 487 km for the same 84 kWh N on 20-inch wheels, so the AU figure is not an NEDC inflation.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Hyundai AU spec sheet 'Electric driving efficiency (kWh/100km) Combined: 18.7' (ADR 81/02); EVDB WLTP 187 Wh/km agrees. Usable/range = 16.4, 14% below, inside tolerance (charging losses).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 'Cargo area rear - VDA 371 L'. CarExpert's database page lists a 45 L frunk, but EVDB and CarExpert's review say no frunk; either way a frunk is not added (owner convention 2026-11-26).

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: No seats-folded figure published by Hyundai AU, EVDB or CarExpert. Spec sheet lists a 60:40 split-fold backrest, but CarExpert's review says folding is of little use behind the fixed chassis brace. Kept the held 700 L (ratio 1.89 to seats-up), between sedan siblings tesla-model-3 (977/594 = 1.64) and byd-seal (950/400 = 2.38).

seats.note: EVDB 5 seats; CarExpert 2027 page lists 3 rear seating positions; spec sheet lists 3 rear top-tether anchors.

towKg.note: Towing capacity braked 'N/A', un-braked 'N/A'; EVDB 0 kg, no tow hitch option.

warrantyYears.note: 7 years/unlimited km only if serviced on time at a Hyundai dealer, otherwise 5 years; unconditional term recorded. Battery 8 years/160,000 km.

insuranceAnnual.note: Matched to hyundai-ioniq-5-n (2750): same E-GMP N powertrain, same ~$115k price. Lowered from the held 2950, which had no recorded evidence for being dearer than the 5 N. Between kia-ev6-gt (2600 at $99,660) and tesla-model-3-performance (3150 at $80,900).

depreciationCurve.note: judged; brand convention (one curve per brand), reconciled at wave-2 integration to the curve most rows of this brand carry
